summary: Frontend-only e2e UI verification of Freeland Family Farms landing page on the public preview URL. Loading screen, navbar, hero (with CTAs), all 11 sections, all card grids (8 products, 6 practices, 3 family, 4 journal), smooth-scroll navigation, contact form submission success state, and mobile responsiveness verified. All Unsplash images loaded (0 broken out of 18). Only 2 console errors observed and both are the expected Pexels video 403s (poster fallback works as called out in the request). No React or runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx: VIDEO_URL Pexels asset returns 403 in this environment; that's handled gracefully by the poster image. If you want zero console noise, gate the <source> tag with a HEAD probe or self-host the mp4. Functionally non-blocking.

Navbar.jsx: Mobile breakpoint hides the nav-link-* anchors via 'hidden md:flex'. They remain in the DOM (so data-testid is queryable) but are visually hidden on <768px. is_visible() still returned True for them on the 1920 viewport check; on the 390 mobile viewport, only logo + 'Say hi' CTA are shown by design. Confirm this is the intended mobile behavior (no hamburger).
App.js: AnimatePresence + body overflow toggle is fine, but if a user reloads mid-loading the scroll-lock still releases via the unmount effect — verified working.
ContactFooter.jsx: handleSubmit only resets local state and shows a 4s success label; this matches the spec ('purely visual contact form'). No PII actually leaves the browser. OK.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this build
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single-page React app, no backend. Critical testids verified: loading-screen, loading-counter, navbar, navbar-logo, navbar-cta, nav-link-{home,story,products,journal,where}, hero-section, hero-cta-shop, hero-cta-contact, story-section, stats-section, products-section, product-card-0..7, sustainability-section, practice-0..5, family-section, family-card-0..2, journal-section, journal-entry-0..3, where-section, testimonials-section, contact-footer, contact-form, contact-name, contact-email, contact-message, contact-submit. Loading screen takes ~3.1s to dismiss (2700ms counter + 420ms exit). When testing, prefer waiting ~4s and querying the DOM rather than wait_for_selector(loading-screen, visible) because by the time Playwright attaches it can already be gone.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The previously reported hero-CTA invisibility (caused by React.StrictMode double-mounting framer-motion) is fully resolved — index.js renders <App /> directly without StrictMode, and both hero-cta-shop and hero-cta-contact are visible immediately after the loading screen exits.
